tick_and_mechanism_notes.tick_rule: BTC tick $1, ETH tick $0.1 (5-significant-figure price rule at current magnitudes)
tick_and_mechanism_notes.spreads: both quoted at 1-tick spread; any mid move requires crossing; no free quote improvement

incident.note: public reporting as relayed in task brief (2026-10-10/11); not independently verified

assumptions: Single ~5s snapshot round; no book replenishment during sweep; no quote pull-back by others.
Bucket depth uniform within bucket range; fine 20 levels exact; labels: asks ceil, bids floor to nSigFigs grid.
After a sweep to last-fill P, next best quote estimated at P +/- tick (uniform central); label variant (next bucket edge) also reported.
Mech A: best bid static. Mech B: marketable limit at P, residual rests at P, becoming best quote on its side.
Unwind: aggressive taker of the exact acquired size through the untouched opposite ladder (no refill / no drift).
Roundtrip slippage $ = (sweep VWAP - mid)*size + (mid - unwind VWAP)*size, sign-adjusted.
Fees: charged on notional of each fill; both legs taker at 4.5bp baseline; variants reported.

interpretation_notes.mech_duality: mechA(m) and mechB(2m) clear the exact same ask range (P identical), so pure-sweep of m bp costs the same as cross-and-rest of 2m bp.
interpretation_notes.unwind_measured_vs_2x_rule: Measured no-refill unwind slippage ~= sweep slippage (mean ratio 1.03, range 0.74-1.35 across all 40 rows); 2x-rule round-trip totals match measured totals within ~+/-20% (rule slightly optimistic in the worst rows).
interpretation_notes.incident_match: ETH $20M flow -> 10-20bp mid matches mechB sweep band ($12.2M@10bp .. $21.8M@20bp) and is consistent with the low end of mechA ($21.8M@10bp); $231M volume / $52k fees = 2.25bp effective, ~6.5 round trips of a 15bp ETH displacement at 2.25bp.
interpretation_notes.boundary_interpolation_caveat: uniform-within-bucket assumption at fine->ns4 boundary gave BTC ask ratio 1.15 vs measured (churn + interpolation), ETH 0.99; treat composite depth as +/-10-30% locally, better far from boundaries.
